QUOTE: `AppDataOperator` (`app/database/operator/app_data_operator/index.ts:15`) extends `BaseDataOperator` directly. It shares `batchRecords`, `prepareRecords`, and `processRecords`, but has none of the handler mixins. It operates on the global app database.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names AppDataOperator as a direct BaseDataOperator subclass sharing the write path (batchRecords) and operating on the app-level database.
